metadata.description: o-MATIC Agency — where an O-Matic factory is staffed. The constitutive operating roster: Probot (orchestrator), Fred (storage and custody), Data (analyst and factory DBA), the factory staleness audit, and the server operating guide.

plugins.name: agency
plugins.description: The constitutive operating layer of an O-Matic factory, as skills only. Probot plans, routes and runs startup; Fred handles storage, file custody and the session log; Data covers schema integrity, retrieval health and factory DBA work; the staleness audit catches retired doctrine still being served as current. Ships no MCP server, so it installs on hosts that cannot spawn one.

metadata.compatibilityTier: prompt-only-behavior-only; MCP-host-full-operation when the host provides the O-Matic Server surface
metadata.requiresForFullOperation: O-Matic Server MCP surface, configured by the host
